topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: When I first heard the allegation, it hit me hard. The words felt heavy, and the implications worse. But as I sat there, the pieces began to fall into place. I recalled the late nights, the sheer volume of reading, and the effort to craft something original. It wasn’t just work; it was a labor of passion. I’m not here to argue against the seriousness of plagiarism—I understand it fully. But I know what I put into this project. I’ve decided to gather all my sources, my notes, and my drafts. I will show where I drew my ideas from and how I developed them. The path ahead is clear, and I’m ready to walk it.
